text:
zoe: Heads-up  my brother's coming by at 1pm with a toddler, two helium balloons, and a big flat-packed shelf (I ordered it). Can we have a guest badge and a little help with the freight elevator? Also the delivery might arrive earlier  can you hold it if it shows up?
front-desk: Yep, we can print a guest badge and coordinate elevator help. Balloons ok in lobby only (no balloons in server room or meeting rooms). We hold deliveries in locker F2. What name for the badge?
zoe: Badge for 'Marco Diaz'. Delivery for "Zoe Park"  item marked "flatpack shelving".
reception-bot: Visitor badge queued for "Marco Diaz" at 12:55. Badge ID: G-6105.
mailroom: Large box for Zoe Park arrived at 11:48  marked "flatpack shelving". Placed in locker F2 with "Do not tip" sticker. No damage.
alan: FYI I can stand by to help with the freight elevator at 12:55if you want someone to ride down with the delivery.
sophia: Also quick PSA  if anyone's bringing balloons please untie them at the front desk and we'll clip them to the lobby post. They drift into the HVAC if left loose.
janitor: Note: big flat boxes sometimes block the dolly area. We'll keep a corridor clear by the loading bay.
front-desk: We'll ring when guest checks in and coordinate a porter for the elevator. Also added sticky "Fragile - Do not tip" to the box.
zoe: Thanks! Could you also note that toddler likes to run  so we'll watch them closely. We'll bring a foldable stroller.
reception-bot: Guest checked in at 13:01. Badge handed to Marco Diaz. Mailroom confirmed box still in F2. Porter  Alan  standing by at loading bay.
mailroom: Quick update  someone tried to take the box earlier but returned it when we called. All good.
alan: Helping move the box up now  elevator reserved for 13:05and dolly in use.
sophia: Balloons clipped and post reserved. Please remind guests not to pop them near the kitchenette  loud toddlers + breakable snacks = chaos.
front-desk: Box moved to the north lounge and assembled area prepped. Mat placed under shelf parts. Porter signed delivery to Zoe Park at 13:12.
zoe: You're all amazing  thank you! We'll keep the toddler contained and the balloons polite.
janitor: All clear  dolly returned and corridor reopened. Closing loop.
